note: Task #6 확장 — Governor 방향 2 (Quality aggregate composite). AX-004 v3 EXCLUSION 직접 활용: 'composite scope 밖 — Quality Defensive Composite(A안)은 scope 밖' 명문 근거. GP + Piotroski + Ohlson + Altman 4-axis quality composite.

hypothesis_summary.name: Quality Aggregate 4-Axis Composite Diversifier
hypothesis_summary.mechanism: 4-axis quality composite: (1) Q01_GPA (Novy-Marx 2013 Gross Profitability), (2) Q04_Piotroski_F (Piotroski 2000 F-Score), (3) signed -z Q25_Ohlson_O (distress probability, lower = higher quality), (4) signed -z Q24_Altman_Z equivalent (distress, lower Z = worse, so higher Z = higher quality). Equal-weight composite (25/25/25/25) → cross-section Z-score → Top 20 EW. Asness-Frazzini-Pedersen 2019 JF 'Quality Minus Junk' framework의 multi-axis quality 구현.
hypothesis_summary.why_now: Governor v1.1 SR 2.0 경로 + AX-004 v3 EXCLUSION 명문 활용. AX-004 v3 원문: '전통 quality composite (Novy-Marx GP + Piotroski F-Score + Ohlson O-Score + Q07 등 복수 quality axis 결합)는 scope 밖 — Scout의 Quality Defensive Composite(A안)은 scope 밖'. H_1689는 4-axis composite로 scope 밖 직접 대응. Quality family는 diversifier 관점에서 Grade A 카탈로그 34건 중 단순 blend 없음.
hypothesis_summary.expected_role_reason: Multi-axis quality는 (1) Value(PBR/EP) family와 구분, (2) Consensus/revision과 구분, (3) Risk/defense와 구분. 기존 Q01-only/Q04-only standalone 실패(AX-004 v1 deprecated scope)와 달리 4-axis diversified composite은 single-axis dilution 회피. Asness-Frazzini-Pedersen 2019 학술 근거.

academic_foundation.primary_reference: Asness, Clifford S., Andrea Frazzini, and Lasse Heje Pedersen, 2019, 'Quality Minus Junk', Review of Accounting Studies 24, 34-112.
academic_foundation.core_reference: Part A 참조번호 TBD + Asness-Frazzini-Pedersen 2019 RAS 'Quality Minus Junk' (multi-axis quality composite foundational)
secondary_references: Novy-Marx, Robert, 2013, 'The Other Side of Value: The Gross Profitability Premium', Journal of Financial Economics 108, 1-28. (Q01 GPA foundation)

Piotroski, Joseph D., 2000, 'Value Investing: The Use of Historical Financial Statement Information to Separate Winners from Losers Among High Book-to-Market Stocks', Journal of Accounting Research 38, 1-41. (Q04 F-Score)
Ohlson, James A., 1980, 'Financial Ratios and the Probabilistic Prediction of Bankruptcy', Journal of Accounting Research 18, 109-131. (Q25 Ohlson O)
Altman, Edward I., 1968, 'Financial Ratios, Discriminant Analysis and the Prediction of Corporate Bankruptcy', Journal of Finance 23, 589-609. (Q24 Altman Z)
Frazzini, Andrea, Israel, Ronen, and Tobias J. Moskowitz, 2013, 'Trading Costs of Asset Pricing Anomalies', Fama-Miller Working Paper. (quality anomaly 실무 실현 가능성)
김재익·이준 (2020), '한국시장의 Quality-Minus-Junk 팩터', 한국재무학회지. (한국 QMJ composite 실증, direct cite 확인 필요)
academic_foundation.mechanism_academic: Asness-Frazzini-Pedersen 2019: quality는 4 dimension(profitability / growth / safety / payout). 각 axis에서 지표 합산 → 'quality' score. High-quality long + low-quality short. 글로벌 24개국 확인. 실무적으로 composite이 single-factor보다 robust (각 axis signal이 unreliable하나 합산 시 noise cancellation).
academic_foundation.korean_specific: 한국 quality 실증: Q01 GPA standalone은 L-139 OOS 소멸, Q04 Piotroski standalone은 L-133 실패, Q25 Ohlson 단독도 BCAC/GSCD cite bucket 1건 제외 standalone 미등록. 단 4-axis composite은 Asness 2019 framework 적용 — 한국 실증 drop-in. Factor DB 4개 factor 모두 기구축.
academic_foundation.ax_004_v3_exemption_justification: AX-004 v3 EXCLUSION 명문: '전통 quality composite (Novy-Marx GP + Piotroski F-Score + Ohlson O-Score + Q07 등 복수 quality axis 결합)은 scope 밖'. H_1689는 정확히 GP(Q01) + F-Score(Q04) + Ohlson(Q25) + Altman(Q24) 4-axis 결합. 단 Q07 미사용 (L-143 Q07 empirical fail 회피). AX-004 v3 직접 해당 exemption.

lesson_check.L_107_ICIR_fixed_weight_C1_violation: DIRECT_FIX — 정적 25%/25%/25%/25% composite. 동적 ICIR weight는 S5 mutation variant.
lesson_check.L_113_quality_defense_fail: AWARE — single-axis quality(Q04 F-Score)는 한국 역방향 defense 실패. H_1689는 4-axis composite 형태로 single-axis 한계 극복 의도. L-113 scope는 single defense, composite는 diversifier.
lesson_check.L_119_static_blend_dilution: CRITICAL — L-119 정확히 해당 리스크 (정적 EW 블렌드). 단 AX-004 v3 EXCLUSION 원문 'Scout의 Quality Defensive Composite(A안)은 scope 밖'은 이 구조 인정. Asness 2019 framework 실증 근거. 단 sub-factor Q24 weak signal이 dilution 유발 여부는 S2 엄격 검증.
lesson_check.L_133_Q04_F_standalone_fail: AWARE — Q04 standalone 실패 scope. H_1689는 4-axis 1/4 비중으로 완화.
lesson_check.L_139_Q01_GP_standalone_fail: AWARE — Q01 standalone 실패. 같은 완화 방식.
lesson_check.L_144_Q24_Altman_stress_reverse: CRITICAL — Q24 stress_icir -0.695 역방향. 단독 사용 시 stress 구간 악화. Composite 내 25% 비중이 rescue하는지 S2 검증 필수. Stress 구간 Q24 기여 분해 요구.
